P4310320595.name: Wiley
P4310320595.note: Publisher-level pages. Green OA embargo is 12-24 months depending on the journal; society-owned titles may set their own terms - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310319900.name: Springer Nature
P4310319900.note: Publisher-level pages; APC varies by journal (see the journal website's Open Access Fees and Funding section). Self-archiving embargo is typically up to 12 months.

P4310319798.name: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
P4310319798.note: ACM moved to fully open access on 2026-01-01 under the ACM Open model; APCs apply to authors at non-participating institutions. There is effectively no green-OA embargo (immediate OA). Policies are publisher-level (ACM does not publish per-journal policy pages); journal home pages are on the ACM Digital Library (dl.acm.org).

P4310311721.name: Cambridge University Press
P4310311721.note: Green OA embargo is typically 6 months (science/medical) to 12 months (humanities/social science) - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310320006.name: American Chemical Society (ACS)
P4310320006.note: Standard green OA embargo is 12 months for hybrid journals; a zero-embargo green OA option exists (see the sharing/public-access page). APC/pricing is via the ACS pricing estimator, not a flat per-journal list.

P4310320083.name: Institute of Physics (IOP)
P4310320083.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months (subscription articles). Full APC price list is downloadable from the APC page; preprints may be shared any time.

P4310320556.name: Royal Society of Chemistry
P4310320556.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months. Gold OA APCs listed on the payments page; RSC members get a 15% discount.

P4310320497.name: Microbiology Society
P4310320497.note: Green OA (self-archiving) and APC terms are on the linked publisher pages; the accepted manuscript may be deposited, and NIH-mandated deposits are allowed with zero embargo.

P4310311847.name: The Company of Biologists
P4310311847.note: Publisher-level pages covering all five journals (Development, Journal of Cell Science, Journal of Experimental Biology, Disease Models & Mechanisms, Biology Open). Self-archiving of the accepted manuscript is allowed (including zero-embargo PMC deposit for NIH compliance) where standard routes do not meet a mandate; the 12-month subscribe-to-open window applies to the three transformative journals. APCs are set per journal - see the linked Journals Gateway open-access overview.

P4310315909.name: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press
P4310315909.note: Publisher-level pages covering the four research journals (Genes & Development, Genome Research, RNA, Learning & Memory), which are Transformative Journals. Articles become free 6 months after publication under the standard subscription route; immediate OA is available via an APC or a transformative agreement. Pre/post-prints may be self-archived; complies with NIH Public Access (6-month). No single general self-archiving page was found on cshlpress.com (per-journal terms pages exist instead), so embargo_sharing points to the CSHL Press landing page.

P4310318509.name: Cogitatio Press
P4310318509.note: Fully open access (all five journals) under CC BY with no embargo; authors retain copyright; SHERPA/RoMEO Green Publisher status. Links go to the publisher's general About page (open access + self-archiving policy) and Institutional Membership page (APC waivers for member institutions); per-journal editorial-policies pages carry the same terms.
